title: Replace placeholder surface with reusable finite terrain and CC0 photogrammetry detail
research_summary: Use ProceduralTerrains 2.0.5 finite runtime for terrain geometry/LOD/material, pin the shared Three.js runtime to 0.185.1 (the common supported intersection of R3F, Drei, postprocessing, ProceduralPlanets and ProceduralTerrains), and add a locally hosted Poly Haven CC0 boulder glTF for near-field photogrammetry detail. Avoid ProceduralTerrains water/cloud pipeline in this slice because the existing planet renderer already owns the orbital atmosphere/cloud stack and the surface goal is only to stop the visual quality drop after landing.

sources.finding: The runtime exposes createTerrain/FiniteTerrain with caller-owned renderer, prepare/update/sampleHeight/dispose, finite noise sources and direct renderer.render support; it explicitly targets three@~0.185.1.
2.0.5 is the current release and reports production runtime/browser validation, 994 frontend tests, 18 API tests, and public npm packaging.
Poly Haven's API is publicly available with a User-Agent requirement; downloaded assets themselves remain CC0 and can be hosted locally instead of depending on the API at runtime.
Poly Haven assets are CC0; locally bundled assets do not carry the live API attribution condition.
Poly Haven PBR assets are photoscanned/photometric, calibrated, seamless and include diffuse/roughness/normal/displacement-style maps, making them suitable for breaking the procedural look.
Three.js ships ImprovedNoise as a stable fallback if the external terrain runtime fails integration.

candidates.name: ProceduralTerrains 2.0.5 finite runtime
candidates.reason: Provides mature finite terrain generation, LOD, built-in terrain shader, height sampling and lifecycle. Isolated build and real WebGL render both succeeded against Three 0.187; mainline will instead pin the documented 0.185.1 peer.

candidates.name: Poly Haven Boulder 01
candidates.reason: Photogrammetry model with LODs and 1K glTF/PBR files adds real near-field rock detail without custom modeling; files will be downloaded and hosted locally.

candidates.name: Three.js ImprovedNoise + custom plane terrain
candidates.reason: Stable fallback with no extra peer constraint, but would require rebuilding terrain LOD/material/sampling behavior that ProceduralTerrains already provides.

candidates.name: ProceduralTerrains water/cloud/render pipeline
candidates.reason: Would introduce another full-scene pipeline and duplicate cloud/water responsibilities before the landing scene itself is proven.

candidates.name: Keep current cone mountains and flat plane
candidates.reason: Already visibly drops quality after cinematic atmospheric entry.

decision.fallback: Three ImprovedNoise if terrain integration regresses the existing orbital renderer.
